---
name: Wrong or missing tariff data, or a source to add
about: A plan is missing, a price is wrong, or you know where a supplier publishes its tariffs
title: "fix(tariffs): "
---

<!-- The tariff data itself lives in https://github.com/macuistin/utility-tariff-data. A problem with a
price, a plan or a country can be raised there too. Raise it here when you are not sure whether the
fault is in the data or in the integration. -->

> **We do not take tariffs typed in by hand.** A hand-typed tariff goes out of date without notice,
> so the store holds only tariffs read from a published page, file or feed. Your own rates can be
> typed into the integration for your own use. If your tariff is not published anywhere we can
> read, suggest the page or feed that will carry it instead of pasting the figures here.

**What is wrong or missing?** (a plan not in the list, a wrong price, a source to read, other)

**Country, supplier and plan**

**Link to where the tariff is published**

**What the integration shows, and what the published page says** (a round-number example is enough,
no account numbers or addresses)

**Integration version** (Settings > Devices & services > Utility Tariffs)
